overview: A modern, responsive personal resume website for Vachan Vinayak Deshnoor, aimed at Business Analytics, Operations and Supply Chain internships.
features: Single-page resume with Home, About, Education, Skills, Projects, Leadership and Achievements, Languages and Contact sections
Sticky navigation bar with smooth scrolling and a mobile hamburger menu
Clean professional design with white background, dark navy text and subtle blue accents
Responsive layout for laptop, tablet and mobile
SEO-friendly semantic HTML with page title and meta description
